messages:
noah: Acme on priv-VPC reported a spike in decrypt failures. Looking at the logs, the decrypt errors have no principal field in audit entries after we tightened egress netpols and removed the sidecar. This makes rollback triage painful. Anyone else seeing audit entries missing principal metadata?

rachel: I see it too. samp audit lines: `WARN audit=zz123 path=/decrypt status=403 reason=authz:principal-missing` — interesting that our audit pipeline shows the request but no `principal` key. Could be shim dropping X-Forwarded-User header when sidecar was removed.

arun: We changed netpol to deny egress from node-pool C to metadata endpoint earlier (policy NP-priv-lockdown). If the keystore-shim relied on metadata token exchange to populate principal, that would explain it. But why 403s now? Is auth happening earlier?

ops-lee: I rolled NP-priv-lockdown at 04:10 UTC. The sidecar removal was part of rollout-PR#823. I can temporarily relax the netpol to allow metadata:80 for the keystore namespace while we debug. Command I'll run: `kubectl apply -f /infra/netpol/priv-keystore-temporary-allow.yaml`.

noah: Before changing netpol, can we enable `audit-verbose=true` on kms-shim to capture full headers + env for 15m? That will help figure out where principal is lost. Security-bot: will enable audit retention extension.

security-bot: action: increased audit retention for namespace priv-keystore by 48h and toggled keystore-shim audit-verbose=true for 15m window upon request by @noah.

rachel: Good. If it's header stripping, we should also check the ingress gateway config and any iptables rules from netpol enforcement (we use eBPF CNI that can drop L7 headers in certain modes).

arun: I validated that metadata talk (169.254.169.254) is allowed for serviceaccount tokens only when hostNetwork enabled; our nodes are hostNetwork=false. The shim used projected tokens; the netpol unintentionally blocked access via kube-proxy hairpin for specific pods.

ops-lee: Relaxed netpol at 04:34 UTC. Waiting to see if principal fields reappear.

priv-customer: confirming: error rates are returning to baseline on our end. Thanks for the quick action.

noah: Next steps (post-incident): 1) update RBAC/netpol rollout checklist to include audit-correlate smoke check (verify principal shows up in sample audit events) 2) add CI preflight that runs `kubectl auth can-i --as=system:serviceaccount:priv-keystore:model-serving decrypt` and validates audit emits principal metadata 3) add a feature flag in keystore-shim to fall back to token-inspection if header absent and log a high-severity warning 4) document the exception for projected-token flows in private VPC runbook. Assigning owners in INC-20260326-C.

rachel: I'll create QA ticket QA-PRIV-210 for the CI preflight.

arun: I'll draft the runbook addendum and the keystore-shim fallback patch.

noah: Great. Leaving the temporary netpol relax in place for 1 hour then remove unless we need more data. Tagging @oncall-sre and closing this thread for now.
